fields.Name: T124 - AI Analytics Compare Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the toggleable Compare button (compareActive / toggleCompare, gated by FilterBarConfig.ShowCompareToggle) - a stateful toggle distinct from chips, section nav, and popover filters.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Analytics section and select a section whose toolbar shows a 'Compare' button (e.g. Executive Summary or Prompt Runs). Click the 'Compare' toggle button (code-compare icon) to turn comparison mode on, then click it again to turn it off. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the Compare button visibly toggles its selected/pressed state and the view acknowledges comparison mode (a compare/period-over-period affordance appears or the button state changes); if a section has no Compare button, note that and treat the toolbar rendering correctly as acceptable.

judgeValidationCriteria: A 'Compare' toggle button is present in at least one analytics section's toolbar
Clicking it toggles its selected state (pressed/active) and toggling again releases it, with the view reflecting comparison mode
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
